To create the mpraΔorf library, barcoded oligos were inserted into SfiI digested pGL4:23:ΔlucΔxbaI by Gibson assembly (NEB, E2611) using 1.1 μg of oligos and 1 μg of digested vector in a 50 μL reaction incubated for 60 min at 50°C. The reaction is then purified by 1.2x SPRI and eluted in 20 μL of elution buffer.

A test transformation was performed to determine the library coverage using 1 μL of ligated vector into 50 μL of electrocompetent 10-beta E. coli (NEB, C3020K) by electroporation (2kV, 200 ohm, 25 μF).

For the scaled-up transformation, 1 μL of the library was transformed into 50 μL of electrocompetent cells. The electroporated cells were recovered in 950 μL SOC media and then immediately split into ten 1 mL aliquots of SOC. These cultures were recovered for an hour at 37°C and then each culture individually expanded in 20 mL LB supplemented with 100 μg/mL of carbenicillin (Sigma-Aldrich, C1389) in shaker at 37°C for 6.5 hours. After completing the incubation, all the cultures were pooled and proceeded for plasmid isolation (Qiagen, 12963).

To create the final mpra:gfp library, 10 μg of mpra:Δorf library plasmid was linearized with 100 units of AsiSI (NEB, R0630) in a final 400 μL reaction and incubated overnight at 37°C. The linearized product was then column purified (Qiagen, 28104) and eluted in 30 μL.

The GFP amplicon was amplified from pMPRAv3:minP-GFP using Q5 NEBNext Hot-Start (NEB M0494), 0.5 μM primer 200 and 0.5 μM primer 201 (table...X), following cycle conditions, 98°C for 30 s, 20 cycles (98°C for 10 s, 60°C for 15 s, 72°C for 45 s), 72°C for 5 min. The amplified product was incubated with DpnI for 30 min at 37°C, followed by 0.5x reverse SPRI and 1.5x forward SPRI purification and eluted in 40 μL EB.

The total recovered volume was re-digested to remove remaining uncut vectors by incubation with 50 Units of AsiSI, 5 Units of RecBCD (NEB, M0345), 10 μg BSA, 1 mM ATP, 1x NEB Buffer 4 in a 100 μL reaction incubated overnight at 37°C followed by 1.5x SPRI purification and elution with 40 μL of EB.

To generate final transfection ready MPRA library, 8 μL of mpra:gfp plasmid was electroporated (2kV, 200 ohm, 25 μF) into 200 μL of 10-beta cells. Electroporated bacteria was recovered in 12 mL SOC and split across 6 2 mL aliquots and incubated for 1 hour at 37°C then each 2 mL culture was expended to 500 mL of LB with 100 μg/mL of carbenicillin and incubated for 16 hours at 37°C and followed by plasmid isolation using Qiagen Gigaprep kit (Qiagen, 12991).

A second PCR was performed to add the individual index primers to each sample. The PCR was performed with 20 μL of purified PCR 1 elute in a 50 μL Q5 NEBNext Ultra II reaction with 0.5 μM of TruSeq_Universal_Adapter primer and Illumina_Multiplex primer containing a unique 8 bp index for sample demultiplexing post-sequencing. Samples were amplified at 98°C for 20 seconds, 6 cycles (98°C for 10 sec, 62°C for 15 sec, 72°C for 30 sec), 72°C for 2 minutes. Indexed libraries were 2x SPRI purified and quantified on Qubit Flex (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Q33326) using dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Q33230) and pooled according to molar estimates from TapeStation (Agilent Technologies, 4200 TapeStation) quantifications.

steps.title: Prepare GFP Amplicon and Insert into Plasmid
steps.instruction: Perform a second PCR using a 1:100 diluted purified PCR1 GFP amplicon as template and column purify the result. Insert this amplicon into the mpraΔorf plasmid via Gibson assembly.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1.6 μg of AsiSI linearized mpraΔorf plasmid and 5.28 μg of the GFP amplicon in a 400 μL reaction.
Incubate for 90 minutes at 50°C.
Perform a 1.5x SPRI purification.

steps.title: Transfect K562 Cells with MPRA Library
steps.instruction: Culture K562s (CIMR) in RPMI medium containing 10% FBS and 1% Pen-Strep. Transfect cells using the Neon transfection system and kit.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1*10^7 cells with 5 μg of MPRA library in 100 μl RPMI and apply three pulses of 1450 V for 10 ms.
For each of five replicates (maintained at ~1 million cells/ml), pellet 1.5*10^8 cells at 200g.
Resuspend pellet in 1.5 ml of Neon transfection kit buffer R containing 150 μg of the TF Motif library.
Recover each replicate at a density of 5*10^5 cells/ml in 300 ml of RPMI medium containing 15% FBS and 1% Pen-Strep.

steps.title: Harvest Cells and Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Recover cells 24 hours post-transfection and prepare for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Pellet cells at 200g and wash once in PBS.
Resuspend cells in 15ml RLT buffer and 300mM DTT.
Homogenize for 1 min at maximum speed and store at –80°C.

steps.title: Elute and DNase Treat RNA
steps.instruction: Elute RNA from beads and perform DNase treatment to remove contaminating DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 μL DEPC treated water (Ambion, AM9906), heat for 2 minutes at 80°C, and collect eluent on a magnet.
Perform a second elution with another 25 μL of water at 80°C.
Perform a third or final DNase treatment by adding 1 μL of Turbo DNase to a total reaction volume of 56 μL.
Incubate for 60 minutes at 37°C, then inactivate with 1 μL of 10% SDS.
Elute final DNase treated GFP mRNA using RNAClean XP SPRI beads (Beckman, A63987) in 35 μL DEPC treated water.

steps.title: Synthesize and Purify First-strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Convert the DNase-treated GFP mRNA into cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Synthesize first-strand cDNA using 30 μL of mRNA with SuperScript III and primer 19 following manufacturer's protocol.
Purify single-stranded cDNA using AMPure SPRI (Beckman, A63881) beads and elute in 30 μL EB.

steps.title: Quantify cDNA via qRT-PCR
steps.instruction: Estimate relative concentrations of GFP cDNA to minimize amplification bias.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 10 μL PCR reaction containing 1 μL cDNA sample, 5 μL Q5 NEBNext Ultra II master mix, 1.7 μL Sybr green I (1:10,000 dilution, Life Technologies, S-7567), and 0.5 μM of TruSeq_Universal_Adapter and MPRA_Illumina_GFP_F primers.
Amplify using the following thermal profile: 98°C for 20 seconds; 40 cycles of (98°C for 10 sec, 62°C for 15 sec, 72°C for 30 sec); 72°C for 2 min; followed by melt curve analysis.
Create a standard curve using serial 10-fold dilutions of the plasmid library (1000 pg to 1 fg) to determine the appropriate plasmid dilution for adaptor ligation based on cDNA threshold cycles.

steps.title: Add Illumina Sequencing Adapters
steps.instruction: Normalize cDNA samples and amplify to add sequencing adapters.

substeps.instruction: Dilute cDNA samples and 5 plasmid library controls to normalize to the replicate with the lowest concentration (highest threshold cycle).
Amplify 10 μL of normalized sample in a 50 μL reaction using qRT-PCR conditions (without Sybr green) for n-1 cycles (where n is the cycle number from qRT-PCR).
Perform 2x SPRI purification on amplified cDNA and elute in 30 μL of EB.

steps.title: Sequence Libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on the Illumina NextSeq 2000 platform.

substeps.instruction: Use 1x20bp reads.
Target 80M reads per cDNA library replicate and 60M reads per plasmid library replicate.
